nodes.text: Select Heroic dungeon difficulty yourself, check today’s saved instance, and enter modern Scholomance. The rare does not spawn in Normal.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

destination.label: Modern Scholomance entrance
destination.directions: Enter Caer Darrow keep and use the ordinary dungeon portal, not Eva’s Enchanted Journal.

nodes.text: In the first classroom, defeat Instructor Chillheart. If her body falls but combat continues, destroy the phylactery and stay ahead of the advancing ice wall.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

nodes.text: Follow the dungeon passage into the illusion room and defeat Jandice Barov. When she splits, find and damage the real Jandice; leave the dangerous ground effects.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

nodes.text: Continue into the bone-filled chamber and defeat Rattlegore. Click a bone pile for Bone Armor if Bone Spike threatens you; avoid the blue Soulflame patches.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

nodes.text: After Rattlegore dies, enter the next room and check for Doctor Theolen Krastinov. His arrival yell announces a spawn; he is not detectable at the dungeon entrance.

recovery.text: If he is absent after Rattlegore, this run has no observed rare opportunity. Do not wait on a guessed respawn or reset a completed Heroic boss for another daily attempt. Use another eligible character or return after the observed reset.

nodes.text: If Krastinov appeared, defeat him and loot Krastinov’s Bag of Horrors. Check the corpse and bag space before leaving.

recovery.text: The rare spawn is uncertain. A Rattlegore kill, yell or Krastinov kill does not prove toy receipt; keep the goal open until the item or ownership is observed.

nodes.writtenDestination: Modern Scholomance: the room immediately beyond Rattlegore’s bone chamber; Krastinov appears here when this run has the rare spawn.

nodes.text: Use Krastinov’s Bag of Horrors from your bags to learn the toy.

recovery.text: Only Toy Box ownership finishes this goal. Loot, mail, an achievement and the guide cursor remain separate evidence.
